                Public Utility Commission of Texas

                                 Memorandum

 TO:            Interested Persons

 FROM:          Jessie Horn, Sr. Counsel, Rules and Projects Division

 DATE:          May 27, 2026

 RE:            Project No. 58317, SB 6 Implementation



Senate Bill (SB) 6, as enacted by the Texas 89th Legislature, Regular Session, was signed
by the governor on June 1, 2025, and took effect immediately. Since the effective date of
SB 6, Commission Staff have worked diligently towards implementing the bill’s various
provisions.

On August 1, 2025, Commission Staff filed a roadmap in the above-described project
detailing Commission Staff’s estimated timeline for implementing SB 6. That roadmap
included estimated dates for gathering information (i.e., the scoping or evaluation period),
Commission consideration for proposal for publication, and Commission consideration of
a recommended adoption order. The estimated dates for the scoping and evaluation periods
began with the effective date of SB 6 and reflect the time frame that Commission Staff is
gathering information, including through informal processes, such as requests for
information, questions for public comment, discussion drafts, and workshops. This
information gathering during the scoping and evaluation periods informs Commission
Staff’s recommended proposal for publication. The estimated dates that were identified for
the Commission’s consideration of Commission Staff’s recommended adoption order are
approximately six months after the estimated date for the associated proposal for
publication to reflect the latest date to complete a project. The six-month time horizon was
chosen based on the requirement in Section 2001.027 of the Texas Government Code that
a rule be adopted six months after the proposal for publication or the rule is considered
withdrawn.

Attached to this memorandum is an update to the roadmap, detailing the progress made in
implementing SB 6 and revised timelines for implementing the remainder of SB 6. The
update to the roadmap reflects the estimated timelines for each project, as reflected in
Commission Staff’s August 1, 2025 memorandum and roadmap, as well as revised
estimated timelines. Below each identified project, is a bulleted list of milestones achieved
and milestones remaining.

This memorandum and the attached roadmap will be placed on the agenda for the June 18,
2026 open meeting for the Commission’s review.

       February 20, 2026 open meeting.

       language before adoption.
   • Commission Staff presented a recommended adoption order and proposed redline changes for the Commission’s consideration at the March
       26, 2026 open meeting
   • The Commission adopted the recommended adoption order and proposed redline changes at the March 26, 2026 open meeting.
Milestones remaining
   • None.
